description: Fixture corpus for scripts/akm-migrate/migrate/task-to-v4.ts (docs/plans/specs/p2b-input-bindings.md §5, Lane C), consumed by tests/migrate/task-v3-to-v4.test.ts. P4 (docs/plans/specs/p4-deletions-closeout.md §3.2) deleted task v3 acceptance from src/ entirely; the typed v3 grammar (parseTaskV3Yaml/parseTaskV3Document) now survives only as the vendored, frozen scripts/akm-migrate/migrate/task-source-v3-frozen.ts copy, and task-to-v4.ts deliberately does not call it either -- it reads each deterministic fixture's INPUT as a raw record through the shared bounded-YAML reader (src/tasks/source/bounded-document.ts's assertBoundedTaskYamlDocument) plus the frozen module's classifyTaskV3Uses for uses: classification only, preserving byte-exact values a typed parser would normalize away. No test runs these fixtures through a full v3 parser, real or frozen. Every blocked fixture is either valid v3 with no safe v4 representation, or a v3-shaped document the migrator's own raw reader must reject on stable, catalogued grounds (never guessed, never silently dropped). The migrator's OUTPUT is validated through the real parseTaskSourceV4 (src/tasks/source/task-source-v4.ts) before a changed outcome is returned (C-N1, B-71). inputs: is never invented by the migrator, so no fixture here declares one.
